focus.title: 欧盟碳边境调节机制过渡期收官在即，中国出口企业须提前布局碳成本核算
focus.summary: 欧盟CBAM过渡期将于2026年底结束，2027年起进入正式征收阶段。中国钢铁、铝、化肥、氢等行业出口企业面临碳排放数据申报与成本传导双重压力。企业应尽快建立产品级碳足迹核算体系，完善供应链碳排放数据收集，并评估在欧盟境内设立合规实体的可行性，以应对即将到来的碳关税成本。
focus.source: 来源：欧盟委员会气候行动总司 · 2026.11.11
focus.title_en: EU CBAM Transitional Period Nears End: Chinese Exporters Urged to Prepare for Carbon Cost Accounting
focus.summary_en: The EU's CBAM transitional period will conclude at the end of 2026, with the definitive regime taking effect in 2027. Chinese exporters in steel, aluminium, fertilisers and hydrogen face dual pressures of emissions data reporting and cost pass-through. Companies should promptly establish product-level carbon footprint accounting systems, enhance supply chain emissions data collection, and assess the feasibility of setting up compliant entities within the EU to prepare for the impending carbon tariff costs.

case.title: 新加坡上诉法院确立跨境在线仲裁条款效力认定标准，对中企合同起草具参考价值
case.summary: 新加坡上诉法院近期在一起跨国电商服务合同纠纷中，认定通过电子邮件往来达成的仲裁条款有效，即使该条款未以传统书面形式签署。法院强调，只要仲裁意图明确且条款可追溯，电子通信形式不影响仲裁协议效力。该判决对中企在跨境合同中采用电子签约方式具有指导意义，建议明确仲裁条款的独立性与电子记录的保存。
case.title_en: Singapore Court of Appeal Sets Standard for Validity of Cross-Border Online Arbitration Clauses, Offering Guidance for Chinese Contract Drafting
case.summary_en: The Singapore Court of Appeal recently upheld an arbitration clause concluded via email exchanges in a cross-border e-commerce service dispute, despite the absence of traditional written signatures. The Court emphasised that electronic form does not affect the validity of an arbitration agreement where the intent to arbitrate is clear and the clause is traceable. This ruling provides guidance for Chinese companies using e-signatures in cross-border contracts, recommending clarity on the severability of arbitration clauses and preservation of electronic records.

policy.title: 粤港澳大湾区推出跨境数据流动便利化新规，允许特定行业试点负面清单管理
policy.summary: 广东省近日发布粤港澳大湾区跨境数据流动便利化措施，在金融、医疗、汽车等特定行业试点数据出境负面清单管理，允许清单外数据自由流动。同时建立粤港澳三方数据安全互认机制，简化安全评估流程。企业应关注行业负面清单的具体范围，利用试点政策优化数据跨境传输合规路径，并同步完善内部数据分类分级管理。
policy.source: 来源：广东省政务服务数据管理局 · 2026.11
policy.title_en: Greater Bay Area Introduces New Measures to Facilitate Cross-Border Data Flows, Piloting Negative List Management in Specific Sectors
policy.summary_en: Guangdong Province recently issued facilitation measures for cross-border data flows in the Greater Bay Area, piloting negative list management for data exports in sectors such as finance, healthcare and automotive, allowing free flow of data outside the list. A tripartite data security mutual recognition mechanism among Guangdong, Hong Kong and Macao has also been established to streamline security assessment procedures. Companies should monitor the specific scope of sectoral negative lists, leverage pilot policies to optimise compliance pathways for cross-border data transfers, and enhance internal data classification and grading management.
policy.source_en: Source: Guangdong Provincial Government Services and Data Management Bureau · 2026.11

analysis.title: 秦林蒿律师研判：美国对外投资审查新规扩围，中企需重构跨境投资合规架构
analysis.summary: 秦林蒿律师研判：美国近期拟进一步扩大对外投资审查范围，将更多涉及人工智能、量子计算等敏感技术领域纳入限制。中企在美投资或与美国主体合作时，应提前进行交易架构审查，识别是否触及“受关注国家”限制，并考虑通过第三地实体或技术许可安排降低风险。建议企业建立投资合规内控机制，在交易前期开展尽职调查，并预留政策变动应对方案。
analysis.source: 来源：秦林蒿律师 · 律连全球 · 2026.11.11
analysis.title_en: Attorney Qin's view: Expanding US Outbound Investment Review Rules Require Chinese Firms to Restructure Cross-Border Investment Compliance Architecture
analysis.summary_en: Attorney Qin's view: The US is reportedly planning to further expand the scope of outbound investment review, adding more sensitive technology sectors such as artificial intelligence and quantum computing to restrictions. Chinese companies investing in the US or cooperating with US entities should conduct early transaction structure reviews to identify whether they fall within restrictions on 'countries of concern', and consider mitigating risks through third-country entities or technology licensing arrangements. It is advisable to establish investment compliance internal control mechanisms, conduct pre-transaction due diligence, and prepare contingency plans for policy changes.
analysis.source_en: Source: Attorney Qin Linhao · iGlobal Law · 2026.11.11
